name: com.crpgtoolkit.core
description: A ruleset-agnostic party-based CRPG engine for Unity: exploration, party control, combat, dialogue, quests and inventory driven entirely by data. The engine has no knowledge of any specific tabletop ruleset; SRD 5.1 (2014-era 5e) content ships as a separate, replaceable ruleset module.

samples.description: A minimal scene demonstrating party movement, selection and interaction.
Reference SRD5 character creation flow using the generic choice-requirement system.
A complete rules-driven combat encounter between two small groups of combatants.
